name: Spokeset
description: Eight fine spokes, close enough to read as a wheel rather than as separate rays.

code.style: --rule: ( --rot: @pick(0deg, 45deg, 90deg, 135deg, 180deg, 225deg, 270deg, 315deg); @random(${shapeFrequency}) { background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-mask: conic-gradient(from 0deg at 50% 50%, #000 0 14deg, transparent 14deg 360deg), conic-gradient(from 45deg at 50% 50%, #000 0 14deg, transparent 14deg 360deg), conic-gradient(from 90deg at 50% 50%, #000 0 14deg, transparent 14deg 360deg), conic-gradient(from 135deg at 50% 50%, #000 0 14deg, transparent 14deg 360deg), conic-gradient(from 180deg at 50% 50%, #000 0 14deg, transparent 14deg 360deg), conic-gradient(from 225deg at 50% 50%, #000 0 14deg, transparent 14deg 360deg), conic-gradient(from 270deg at 50% 50%, #000 0 14deg, transparent 14deg 360deg), conic-gradient(from 315deg at 50% 50%, #000 0 14deg, transparent 14deg 360deg); mask: conic-gradient(from 0deg at 50% 50%, #000 0 14deg, transparent 14deg 360deg), conic-gradient(from 45deg at 50% 50%, #000 0 14deg, transparent 14deg 360deg), conic-gradient(from 90deg at 50% 50%, #000 0 14deg, transparent 14deg 360deg), conic-gradient(from 135deg at 50% 50%, #000 0 14deg, transparent 14deg 360deg), conic-gradient(from 180deg at 50% 50%, #000 0 14deg, transparent 14deg 360deg), conic-gradient(from 225deg at 50% 50%, #000 0 14deg, transparent 14deg 360deg), conic-gradient(from 270deg at 50% 50%, #000 0 14deg, transparent 14deg 360deg), conic-gradient(from 315deg at 50% 50%, #000 0 14deg, transparent 14deg 360deg); -webkit-transform: rotate(@var(--rot)); transform: rotate(@var(--rot)); } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
